newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Buenos Aires sells power plant to Camuzzi group.
newsitem.headline: Buenos Aires sells power plant to Camuzzi group.

text.p: A consortium headed by Italy's Camuzzi Wednesday won the tender for the purchase of an electric power plant in Buenos Aires province.

Three power plants were on offer for sale in the tender held by Buenos Aires province's energy firm Eseba, but bids were only received for the Luis Piedrabuena de Bahia Blanca electricity plant, state news agency Telam reported.
The Camuzzi-led bid was $30.3 million while the second bidder, Corporacion Independiente de Energia, led by by the U.S. E-Prime group, presented a bid of $20.5 million.
The tender of Eseba's electricity generation units came after the splitting of the company between its energy transmission, distribution and energy generating units.
Argentina's Transener SA won the 95-year concession to operate Eseba's energy transmission unit earlier this month.
The Bahia Blanca plant has an installed capacity of 620 MW.
This is the second tender for the plants after a sale in April was called off because the bids were too low.
The other two plants, in Mar del Plata and Necochea, remain in Eseba's hands. Telam did not say whether there would be a new tender for those plants after no bids were received for them Wednesday.
